intro: Tannok Frosthammer is a dwarven resident found at Thunderbrew Distillery outside Kharanos in Dun Morogh. He serves as an anxious recipient of goods coming from Coldridge Valley, deeply troubled by how trogg attacks have cut off the roads to Anvilmar.

p: Stationed around the Thunderbrew Distillery in Kharanos, Tannok Frosthammer keeps a watchful eye on incoming deliveries and local tidings. The sudden surge of troggs swarming Coldridge Pass has severed normal transit from Coldridge Valley, leaving Tannok cut off from regular communication with the settlement at Anvilmar. Relying on couriers like the gnome tinkerer Hands Springsprocket to ferry vital supplies and news through the perilous, snowy mountain pass, Tannok represents the quiet worry shared by many Bronzebeards as subterranean threats crawl closer to their doorsteps.
